doc_name: 石化产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 进一步增强石化产业的支柱产业地位
quote_en: Further strengthen the pillar-industry status of the petrochemical industry.
notes: Headline of a dedicated plan; broad concept spanning 石油石化 and 基础化工 -> none; sub-sectors coded separately. Targets: crude throughput 405 Mt, ethylene 15.5 Mt by 2011. Restriction side: 严格控制炼油乙烯新布点, 淘汰落后产能, 遏制煤化工盲目发展 (see separate rows); dominant = stabilise and grow (judgement).

doc_name: 石化产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 严格控制炼油乙烯项目新布点
quote_en: Strictly control new siting of refining and ethylene projects.
notes: Repeated in three places; eliminate refineries of 1 Mt/y and below, close/merge 1-2 Mt units. Support side: finish 6 refinery and 8 ethylene projects already under construction; 2-3 large refinery expansions; fuel-quality upgrading. Mixed; restriction judged dominant.

doc_name: 石化产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 坚决遏制煤化工盲目发展势头，积极引导煤化工行业健康发展
quote_en: Resolutely curb blind expansion of coal chemicals while actively guiding healthy development.
notes: Dedicated section titled 稳步开展煤化工示范; no new pilot projects in principle; demonstration of five coal-to-X types (oil, olefins, DME, methane, glycol) continues.

doc_name: 石化产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 今后三年停止审批单纯扩大产能的焦炭、电石等煤化工项目
quote_en: For the next three years stop approving coke, calcium carbide and other coal-chemical projects that merely add capacity.

doc_name: 石化产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 加快淘汰电石、甲醇等产品的落后产能
quote_en: Speed up elimination of backward capacity in calcium carbide, methanol and similar products.

doc_name: 石化产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 严格控制甲醇、烧碱、纯碱等产能过剩行业项目建设
quote_en: Strictly control project construction in overcapacity industries such as methanol, caustic soda and soda ash.
notes: Same sentence as 炼油乙烯新布点.

doc_name: 石化产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 支持化肥骨干生产企业储备磷铵和尿素
quote_en: Support leading fertiliser producers to stockpile ammonium phosphate and urea.
notes: Dedicated tasks 提高农资保障能力 and 完善化肥储备机制; target 62.5 Mt output. Restriction side: 上大压小，产能置换，淘汰技术落后…产能.

doc_name: 石化产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 在能源产地适当建设大型氮肥生产装置，替代落后产能
quote_en: Build large nitrogen-fertiliser units appropriately at energy-producing sites to replace backward capacity.
notes: Restructuring of feedstock and power mix (clean coal gasification); guided adjustment rather than expansion.

doc_name: 石化产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 继续建设好云南、贵州、湖北三大磷肥基地
quote_en: Keep building the three big phosphate bases in Yunnan, Guizhou and Hubei.
notes: Also 支持骨干磷肥企业通过兼并重组.

doc_name: 石化产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 加大国内外钾矿资源勘探开发，科学规划青海、新疆钾肥基地发展
quote_en: Step up domestic and overseas potash exploration and development and plan the Qinghai and Xinjiang potash bases.
notes: Target: potash output 4 Mt (as pure nutrient) by 2011; 支持钾肥龙头企业开展产业整合.

doc_name: 石化产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 调整农药产品结构，发展高效低毒低残留品种，推动原药集中生产
quote_en: Adjust the pesticide product mix, develop high-efficiency low-toxicity low-residue varieties and concentrate technical-grade production.
notes: Restriction side: 淘汰一批高毒高风险农药品种. Guided restructuring; judged neutral.

doc_name: 石化产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 重点支持油品质量升级、化肥农药结构调整、高端石化产品发展
quote_en: Give priority support to fuel-quality upgrading, fertiliser/pesticide restructuring and high-end petrochemical products.
notes: Includes butyl rubber, isoprene rubber, caprolactam; target of markedly higher self-sufficiency; 做强高端石化产业.

doc_name: 石化产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 抓住当前有利时机增加成品油国家储备
quote_en: Seize the current opportunity to add to the national refined-oil reserve.
notes: Also commercial reserve scheme, consumption-tax reform and pricing mechanism favourable to the industry. Regulatory side: 严禁达不到国家规定标准的油品进入市场; 严厉打击成品油走私.

doc_name: 石化产业调整和振兴规划
concept_zh: 石油天然气资源勘探开发
concept_en: oil and gas exploration and development
quote_zh: 加大国内石油资源勘探开发力度，稳定石化产业原料的国内供给
quote_en: Step up domestic oil exploration and development to stabilise domestic feedstock supply.
notes: Also 支持国内有实力的企业开展境外油气、钾矿、硫资源开发与合作. SW 石油石化 has no upstream L2 in the taxonomy; 炼化及贸易 used as the nearest.
